* Test your skill and knowledge in a limited time gamemode where all your units are replaced by random units and spells! Some spells allow you to use units you equipped, so make sure to experiment!  
** Instead of your units, you get a new unit to place every few seconds, so make sure you pick carefully which units to place!  
** Obtain event currency by completing waves, and pick modifiers every few waves to affect the game!  
** You may sometimes receive a spell to use instead of a unit, which can have very powerful effects!  
* Brand new unique units to collect, upgrade, and evolve!  
* New units provide increased drop rate and damage in the new gamemode!  
* New Limited-Time Secret Unit!  

* New Featured unit pity added to Special and Legacy banners!  
* There is now a pity to guarantee the featured MIDDLE mythic!  
* New Secret unit pity added to April Fools Banner!  
* Added 10 tiers to the current Battlepass!  

* New Quality of Life Features:  
** Unit View UI now shows Passive abilities! More information for older units will be added over time!  
** Quick Summon setting added! Enable to skip the first part of any summoning animation!  
** Enemy targetted by units are now highlighted in game!  
** In game placement UI updated to show more unit information when hovering over them!  
** Enemy health UI revamped to more cleanly show resistances and modifiers!  
** Daily Infinite quest shortened from 50 to 40 waves!  
** Critical Damage now works as a true multiplier to damage!  

* New unit mechanics!  
* Lots of new Cosmetics added to units!  
* More units have become tradable!  
* Balance changes + bug fixes!

New World: Shibuya!  
* Brand new unique units to collect, upgrade, and evolve!<br><br>  
* New Evolve Quests and Special Quests!  
* All new units have increased drop rate and damage in new Portals!  
* Event shop added! Exchange Sacred Treasures daily for rewards! (Speak with Gambler in the lobby)  
* New Limited-Time Secret Units!  
* New Gamemode: [[Dungeon]]!  
** Step into the dungeon once you receive a [[Items|dungeon key]]!  
** Buy dungeon keys by talking to Gambler in the lobby and opening his shop! Get a free key from login rewards daily!  
** Every dungeon is randomly generated and has different levels to play!  
** Collect chests through the rooms and open them for rewards at checkpoints or at the end of the Dungeon!  
** Open chests early at checkpoints, or wait to open at the end of the Dungeon for a chance at receiving a secret unit!  
** Pick up money from Hoard rooms to use on shops in the dungeon!  
** Buy powerful weapons from shops to help your run or greatly boost rewards!  
** Receive cursed items which challenge your skills!  
** If you're up for it, receive stronger cursed items from shrines at a chance to greatly boost your rewards!  
** Complete the whole dungeon for a chance to get a special limited secret unit!

* New Battle Pass: Lily Hunt!  
* A new battle pass has released, along with new units to collect! Progress through the battle pass by taking down enemies in any game mode!  

* New Quests added, make sure to complete them for exciting rewards!  
* Lots of new unit mechanics and evolutions!  

* Ashborn added back to the banner!  
* Curse debuff cooldown rate removed!  

* New Quality of Life Features:  
** Unit Overview added!  
** Press F in game to toggle the unit overview! You can view, upgrade, sell, select, all your units there!  
** Worthiness changed, now max worthiness is 400%, but each reroll still uses up to 100%!  
** Stat reroll now asks for confirmation if you reroll S tier stats!  

* Evolve requirements for some units reduced!  
* More units have become tradable!  
* Balance changes + bug fixes!

New Gamemode/Event: Assassin Contracts! 
* Accept high-stakes contracts to eliminate powerful targets! The stronger the target, the rarer the contract, but the rewards are worth the risk!  
* Every contract has different modifiers and deadly countermeasures. Use strategy and quick thinking to survive!  
* Go solo or squad up with other assassins through global matchmaking!  
* Complete contracts to earn big payouts, with a chance at exclusive rewards!  

* Brand new unique units to collect, upgrade, and evolve!
* New units have increased damage and drop rate boost in Assassin Contracts!  
* New Unique Relic added with a powerful effect!  

New Raid: The Spider!  
* Complete enough raids for a guaranteed unit!
* Beat new raid quests to earn extra rewards!  
* Speak with Legendary Assassin in the lobby for more information!  

Quality of Life (QOL) Updates:  
* Graphics update for most maps!  
* Roblox Chat upgrade!  
* Idol now negates High Cost debuffs!  
* Stat Potentials are now more visible and appear in more UIs!  
* Targeting modes now use a dropdown menu!  
* Damage Type buffs/resistances show in-game!  
* Active ability cooldowns now show in-game!  
* Color coding for upgrade levels improved!  
* Notifications added whenever a Quest is completed!  
* Takedowns in level now visible on in-game UI next to damage dealt!  
* Teams UI revamp! Load, save, and rename teams without hassle! Damage types also shown on your Teams for visual clarity!  
* If you try to equip a unit while already at the max limit, you'll now be prompted to swap it with another unit!  
* Keybinds added for upgrading/selling unit (R and X)! Emote keybind remapped to Z!  

Fixes & Changes:  
* Challenge rewards bug fixed!  
* New unit mechanics!  
* More units have become tradable!  
* Balance changes + bug fixes!

* Four New Limited-Time Holidays and re-release Bundles!

* New Feature: Limit Break!
**  Fuse together strong units to break the limits of a selected unit! Talk to Fused Hero next to the Evolve area to limit break your units! 
**  Limit breaking a unit increases past their max level, and each equipped Limit Broken unit powers up your entire team with a +5% damage boost (stacks additionally)!
**  Limit breaking a unit also unlocks new mysterious powers that unlock soon!
**   Evolved units contribute more progress towards limit breaking a unit (unevo = 1, evo = 2, you need a totl of 12)!

* New Feature: Trait transfer!
**  Sacrifice units to transfer traits to another of the same unit, with a 100% chance to succeed!

* Event: Present Hunt!
**  Presents have appeared! Defeat enemies holding presents, and turn them in to Rookie Hunter to obtain rewards!

* New Player level rewards added!
**  Gain rewards for reaching player level milestones! Talk to Prayer Master to claim your rewards! Check back often for more milestone reward increases!

* New Holiday Rewards calendar added!
**  Enjoy free rewards for logging in every day!

* Legacy disenchant feature!
**   Several legacy units can now be disenchanted for free rewards to help you catch up!
**   Obtain legacy gems, trait rerolls, and gifts and shiny luck potions for disenchanting units!
**   Spend legacy gems on the legacy banner to obtain older units to quickly catch up!
**   Convert gems to legacy gems via the banner if you want!

* Challenge rewards increased, Daily Challenge rewards significantly increased!

* Auto-sell setting added for Skins!

* You can now select units and change your team before the game starts! You no longer need to leave to the lobby to do so!

* More unit information available on in-game unit overhead!
* Added option to join Global Matchmaking for Holiday Event, along with Infinite, Legend Stages, and Halloween Event!
* Added UI improvements!
* Lobby upgraded and improvements!
* Exclusive rarity added for leaderboard and tournament units!
* New enemy type: Burst Enemies! Burst Enemies have an initial burst of speed but slow down later!
* Added matchmaking improvements!
* Halloween Event here to stay a bit longer!
* More units have become tradable!
* Back to lobby setting added!
* Cosmetics added to some units!
* New Settings added for lobby music!
*Paths indicators option added for games on top right!
*Unit upgrade number information now appears in game!
*Emotes now play on your units as well!
*Most Rares, Epics and Legendaries along with some old Mythics/Secrets buffed!
*Trait visual effects improvements!
*You can now rotate units when viewing/summoning them with Q and E!
*New Emotes!
*Snowball Throw emote is back for a limited time in the trophy shop!
*New Titles added!
*More World Skips!
*New Event Quests!
*Balance changes + bug fixes!

Participate in the new anniversary event and check out the new exciting features and units! Be sure to check out Guilds to play and compete with your friends!
*New Feature: Guilds (Beta)!
**Guild area in the Lobby opened!
**Talk to [[Melio]] to create your own Guild! Or join an existing one via invitation!
**Set a Guild icon, Guild colors, description and announcment to customize your Guild!
